{{External|rs|rsc=Milk}} {{Infobox Item |name = Bucket of milk |image = [[File:Bucket of milk.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Empty, Drop |examine = It's a bucket of milk. |value = 6 |weight = 2.200 |respawn = 100 |exchange = Yes |id = 1927 }} [[File:Bucket of milk detail.png|left|130px]] A '''bucket of milk''' is a [[Cooking]] ingredient used to make a variety of drinks and foods such as [[choc saturday]]s and [[cake]]s, as well as several [[pet feeder space|feeders]]. Players can use a [[bucket]] on a [[dairy cow]] or [[dairy buffalo]] to create a bucket of milk, or simply click on the cow or buffalo with at least one empty bucket in the [[inventory]]. Players can turn a bucket of milk into [[chocolatey milk]] by adding [[chocolate dust]], or add milk to [[nettle tea]] (though this does not add any effects). Depending on their Cooking level, [[Members]] can use a [[dairy churn]] to turn a bucket of milk into a [[pot of cream]], a [[pat of butter]], or a piece of [[cheese]]. A bucket of milk is required to complete the [[quests]] [[Cook's Assistant]], [[Gertrude's Cat]], [[Plague City]] (to make a [[Hangover cure]]), and the [[Skippy and the Mogres]] [[Miniquests|miniquest]] (to make a hangover cure). This, alongside the [[chocolatey milk]], [[milky mixture]], and [[hangover cure]], can be stored in a [[bottomless milk bucket]]. Each bottomless milk bucket can only store one type of dairy product at a time. ==Creation== {{Recipe |members = No |ticks = 3 |ticksnote = Left-clicking a [[dairy cow]] or [[dairy buffalo|buffalo]] is 3 ticks, using a bucket is 4 ticks. Auto-milking after either of those two methods is 8 ticks. |facilities = Dairy cow |mat1 = Bucket |mat1qty = 1 |output1 = Bucket of milk |output1num = 1 }} ==Uses== ===Quests=== *[[Cook's Assistant]]: 1 × bucket of milk *[[Plague City]]: 1 × bucket of milk to make [[chocolatey milk]] *[[Gertrude's Cat]]: 1 × bucket of milk *[[Ghosts Ahoy]]: 1 × bucket of milk *[[A Tail of Two Cats]]: 1 × bucket of milk *[[Ratcatchers]]: 1 × bucket of milk *[[Recipe for Disaster]] ([[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf|Freeing the Mountain Dwarf]] subquest): 1 × bucket of milk ===Miniquests=== *[[Skippy and the Mogres]]: 1 × bucket of milk to make chocolatey milk ===Pets=== A bucket of milk can also be used to feed kittens.
